entries.name: vDSP_vsmsa
entries.signature: void vDSP_vsmsa(const float *__A, vDSP_Stride __IA, const float *__B, const float *__C, float *__D, vDSP_Stride __ID, vDSP_Length __N)
entries.notes: Vector scalar multiply and scalar add: D[i] = A[i] * B + C. Single call replaces multiply + subtract. Ideal for channel normalization (pixel * scale + offset).

entries.name: vDSP_vsmsb
entries.signature: void vDSP_vsmsb(const float *__A, vDSP_Stride __IA, const float *__B, const float *__C, vDSP_Stride __IC, float *__D, vDSP_Stride __ID, vDSP_Length __N)
entries.notes: Vector scalar multiply and vector subtract: D[i] = A[i] * B - C[i]. Useful for (pixel * scale - mean) in one pass.

entries.name: vDSP_vdiv
entries.signature: void vDSP_vdiv(const float *__B, vDSP_Stride __IB, const float *__A, vDSP_Stride __IA, float *__C, vDSP_Stride __IC, vDSP_Length __N)
entries.notes: Vector divide: C[i] = A[i] / B[i]. Note unusual arg order: divisor B comes first.

entries.name: vDSP_vsmul
entries.signature: void vDSP_vsmul(const float *__A, vDSP_Stride __IA, const float *__B, float *__C, vDSP_Stride __IC, vDSP_Length __N)
entries.notes: Vector scalar multiply: C[i] = A[i] * B. Faster than numpy scalar multiply for large arrays.

entries.name: vDSP_vsadd
entries.signature: void vDSP_vsadd(const float *__A, vDSP_Stride __IA, const float *__B, float *__C, vDSP_Stride __IC, vDSP_Length __N)
entries.notes: Vector scalar add: C[i] = A[i] + B. Useful for bias/offset operations.

entries.name: vDSP_vfltu8
entries.signature: void vDSP_vfltu8(const unsigned char *__A, vDSP_Stride __IA, float *__C, vDSP_Stride __IC, vDSP_Length __N)
entries.notes: Convert unsigned uint8 array to float32 in one vectorized pass. Use this (not vDSP_vflt8 which is signed char). Replaces arr.astype(np.float32). Chain with vDSP_vsmsa for fused convert+normalize.

steps.args_hint: const float *A, vDSP_Stride IA, const float *B, const float *C, float *D, vDSP_Stride ID, vDSP_Length N
steps.notes: D[i] = A[i] * B + C. For ImageNet normalize: scale = 1/(255*std), offset = -mean/std. One call per channel replaces 3 numpy ops (divide + subtract + divide).

protocols.recipe:
import ctypes, numpy as np
_acc = ctypes.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/Accelerate.framework/Accelerate')

def vdsp_normalize_channel(uint8_channel, mean, std):
    """Normalize a single uint8 image channel to float32: (pixel/255 - mean) / std.
    Equivalent to: (arr.astype(float32) / 255.0 - mean) / std
    Uses vDSP_vfltu8 (unsigned uint8->float) + vDSP_vsmsa (scale+add) in 2 native calls
    instead of 3 numpy operations."""
    ch = np.ascontiguousarray(uint8_channel)  # ensure contiguous for stride=1
    n = ch.size
    fp = np.empty(n, dtype=np.float32)
    # Step 1: uint8 -> float32 (5-arg: A, IA, C, IC, N)
    _acc.vDSP_vfltu8(ch.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ubyte)),
                     ctypes.c_long(1),
                     fp.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)),
                     ctypes.c_long(1), ctypes.c_ulong(n))
    # Step 2: D[i] = fp[i] * (1/(255*std)) + (-mean/std)  -- fused scale+offset
    scale = ctypes.c_float(1.0 / (255.0 * std))
    offset = ctypes.c_float(-mean / std)
    _acc.vDSP_vsmsa(fp.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), ctypes.c_long(1),
                    ctypes.byref(scale), ctypes.byref(offset),
                    fp.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)), ctypes.c_long(1),
                    ctypes.c_ulong(n))
    return fp.reshape(uint8_channel.shape)

steps.args_hint: const unsigned char *A, vDSP_Stride IA, float *C, vDSP_Stride IC, vDSP_Length N
steps.notes: Convert unsigned uint8 array to float32 vectorized. Use vDSP_vfltu8 (not vDSP_vflt8 which takes signed char). Much faster than numpy astype(float32) for large arrays.

protocols.recipe:
import ctypes, numpy as np
_acc = ctypes.CDLL('/System/Library/Frameworks/Accelerate.framework/Accelerate')

def vdsp_uint8_to_float(arr_u8):
    """Convert uint8 numpy array to float32 using vectorized vDSP.
    Uses vDSP_vfltu8 (unsigned). Do NOT use vDSP_vflt8 — that takes signed char,
    so pixel values 128-255 become negative floats."""
    arr = np.ascontiguousarray(arr_u8)  # ensure contiguous for stride=1
    n = arr.size
    out = np.empty(n, dtype=np.float32)
    # 5-arg signature: A, IA, C, IC, N
    _acc.vDSP_vfltu8(arr.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ubyte)),
                     ctypes.c_long(1),
                     out.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float)),
                     ctypes.c_long(1), ctypes.c_ulong(n))
    return out.reshape(arr_u8.shape)
